description: This file defines the SearchStore class, which manages search queries and results for destinations in an Angular application. It exposes observables for query, results, loading status, and errors, and handles debounced search requests using RxJS operators.

classes.name: SearchStore
classes.description: A service class that manages destination search queries and results, providing reactive streams and search logic.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the SearchStore, setting up reactive pipelines to perform searches upon query changes with debounce.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the search query which triggers a new search.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Triggers a search with the provided query or reuses the current query if none is provided.

methods.name: performSearchOnce
methods.description: Performs a single search operation for the given query, handles errors, and returns destination results.

methods.name: performSearch
methods.description: Creates an observable stream that executes the search operation for the given query.
